Name: Easy Farm Switcher
Author: DeLiXxN
Description:
[size=4][b]Instructions
[/b]- - - - - - - - - - -

Use the new button [img]https://gitlab.com/delixx/stardew-valley-custom-farm-loader/-/raw/main/Custom%20Farm%20Loader/Assets/CustomFarmIcon.png[/img] in your ingame options menu to change the farm type.
Please backup your savefile at [b]%appdata%\StardewValley\Saves
[/b]This mod was intended to be used in SinglePlayer; You can always host your multiplayer session afterwards.
Saving and reloading your savefile from the title menu after changing farm types is recommended

[color=green][size=5]✔[/size][/color] Vanilla Farm

[color=green][size=5]✔[/size][/color] CFL based Custom Farm
